title: Electronic signing and your copy
text: Read the whole packet before signing. By choosing to sign electronically in DocuSeal, you agree to use electronic records and signatures for this packet. Sign only for the party you are authorized to represent. You need a browser that can open your private link and a way to view, save or print PDFs. After BEASTY countersigns, you can download the completed documents and signing record. Contact glenn@beastypages.com for paper copies, an alternative signing arrangement, access help or to withdraw consent to future electronic records and signatures. Withdrawing consent does not cancel signatures or records already provided.

title: Tax information and accurate details
text: Provide the correct taxpayer name, classification and taxpayer identification number on the official IRS Form W-9 when that form applies to you. Follow its instructions and read its certification before signing. BEASTY uses the completed form for payment administration and applicable tax reporting. Saved application details may be prepared for you, but you must check that they match the taxpayer and account holder. Do not guess a tax classification or identification number. Contact BEASTY before signing if your number is pending or a different tax form applies.

title: Direct deposit authorization
text: Your signed bank form authorizes BEASTY to credit affiliate payments to the account you identify. It does not authorize account debits. Confirm the account holder, routing number, account number and account type before signing. Supply details only for an account you own or are authorized to use. An optional voided check or bank letter can help BEASTY check those details. Send changes or a revocation to glenn@beastypages.com and arrange a secure replacement form; allow a reasonable processing period. Do not email bank numbers or upload a check with a live payment instruction.

title: Identity documents and secure handling
text: Upload a legible image of the requested current driver's license, state ID or passport identity page directly to DocuSeal. Upload the reverse only if BEASTY requests it. BEASTY reviews the document to check who receives payments; an upload alone does not verify identity or approve an application. Taxpayer numbers, bank numbers and ID images stay in the document service and are not stored in the BEASTY application database. That database holds your application details and review status. Do not send these sensitive documents by ordinary email.

title: Document access, corrections and retention
text: BEASTY and its document service handle the packet for onboarding, identity review, payment administration and applicable tax reporting. Access is limited to personnel authorized to perform those tasks. Records are retained for those purposes and applicable recordkeeping or dispute obligations. To request access, correct information, replace a document or ask about retention or deletion, contact glenn@beastypages.com. Do not include taxpayer or bank numbers in that email. BEASTY will arrange a secure channel and assess the request against any records it is required to retain.

title: Disclose your affiliate relationship
text: When promoting BEASTY, make the financial relationship clear where people see or hear the recommendation. Ready-to-use wording is: I am a BEASTY affiliate and may earn a reward when you join through my referral. Put the disclosure with the endorsement, before any More link; do not bury it in a profile or a group of hashtags. For video, include visible text in the video and a spoken disclosure when it has speech. Repeat it during live streams and use the same language as the promotion. A platform's paid-partnership label can supplement your disclosure.

title: Truthful promotion and reward terms
text: Describe your actual experience and use current, approved BEASTY information. Do not invent product claims, reviews, customers or referrals, promise guaranteed earnings, or imply that you can bind BEASTY. Rewards, qualification rules, adjustments and payment timing are governed by the final agreement supplied by BEASTY, which you should read before signing. Promotional multipliers, bonuses, cryptocurrency payments and automatic payouts apply only if expressly included in that agreement. Your promotional work and expenses are your responsibility, subject to the agreement and any legally required classification.

title: Contact and application review
text: BEASTY uses your application contact details for invitations, access codes, document preparation, status updates and payment-related questions. Completing this packet does not enroll you in promotional text messages. You may ask to update your contact details or stop the application process by contacting glenn@beastypages.com. After you complete and sign the packet, return to the applicant page and request review. BEASTY checks the documents and signing record, countersigns the approved agreement and separately decides your application. Requesting review does not itself confirm a signature or an approval.
